text.en:
Section twenty-four hundred and forty-four of the Revised Administrative Code is hereby
amended by inserting after subsection (a) of said section the following additional subsection:
"(aa) To authorize the free distribution of medicine by the city physician to the employees and laborers of the
city, and of fresh native milk, if available, to indigent mothers residing in the city."

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, December 2, 1932.
